node.statement: Lemma 5.2 (First moment operator): M_mom^{(1)} = (1/n) X_{n+1} (Pi_sym^n tensor I). Proof: From Lemma 5.1 with k=1, d[n](d+n) integral |u><u|^{n+1} du = (e+X_{n+1})(Pi_sym^n tensor I). The GPS debiasing subtracts (1/n)Pi_sym^n tensor I and rescales, yielding M_mom^{(1)} = (1/n)X_{n+1}(Pi_sym^n tensor I).
